title: Bookshops & Bonedust
author: Travis Baldree
summary: This prequel to Legends & Lattes follows a younger orc mercenary who is injured on a job and has to spend weeks recovering in a seaside town. There she meets a small community and a bookshop that begins to change her view of her life.
readIf: you want a gentle, low-stakes fantasy about rest, friendship and a very small bit of adventure.
skipIf: you want tight plotting or big danger, as it is deliberately unhurried.

pairings.reason: The book that follows chronologically and has a similar warm, restful feeling.
Another short, soothing story about someone recovering their sense of purpose.
Another cosy fantasy about a small, odd community that changes a lonely person's life.
